title: New year! New Chance!
flavor: The real joy of Frostivus used to mean something. It wasn't about your friends, your family, or your feelings. It lies not in the sweet party cookies or the Jingle Fist but in the atmosphere filled with the happiness of friends and family gathering. New equipment is one of many expectations for the new year. As the old year fades away with snowflakes gently falling, past disappointments no longer haunt us, and everyone gets another chance.

entries.name: Adjustment to Relic Duration
entries.detail: The duration of Relic is now calculated from the moment of selection. The item expires at the start of the preparation round 10 rounds later (originally, it expired at the end of the neutral round battle of the next multiple of 10 rounds). Example: If you select a Mango Tree from the Relic box on round 14, your Mango Tree will expire at the start of the preparation round on round 25 (originally, it expired at the end of the neutral round battle on round 20). Note: Due to the removal of restrictions on the selection time of Relics, the error-tolerant rule stating that Greedy Egg hatches at the beginning of rounds 10 and 11 are considered round 10 has been removed.

entries.name: After each Relic selection, you will no longer randomly encounter the same item from the remaining Relic boxes in the game
Reset of "Taunt" Mechanism
entries.detail: Chess pieces with Taunt will now consistently attract nearby enemy chess pieces for priority attacks (originally, the taunt effect caused a one-time diversion of enemy attacks at the moment of taunting). Note: Affected by the Taunt mechanism: Axe - Berserker's Call, Beastmaster - Battle Bear, Centaur - Totem of the Clan, Giant's Ring, Bloodthorn. Note: Priority order for attacking within a chess piece's attack range: Target with Taunt > Hunters, items like new Phase Boots prioritise lower-health targets > Summoned units attack the target marked by Chestnut > Seeking the nearest attackable target > Low-priority targets like Cold Embrace, Empty Blood Vial, etc.

entries.name: Second Chance
entries.detail: Reworked Effect (Now it's a true "Second Chance!") When you use consumable items of the choice category, you can refresh the selection panel and acquire different options. Note: Items eligible for the refresh chance include Heart of Machine, Golden Heart of Machine, Dark Heart of Machine, Loot Box, and the next Relic box.

entries.name: New T2 Item
entries.detail: Phase Boots (Active effect exclusive to melee chess pieces) Enables quick movement. <Active Skill: Instant Cast> Melee carriers will phase through obstacles, swiftly moving to the vicinity of an enemy chess piece with lower health in the range and prioritizing an attack on it. Effect Range: 600 Cooldown: 5 seconds

entries.name: Giant's Ring
entries.detail: Upgraded from T2 to T4. Reworked Effect: Physical Block +60. Permanent Taunt.

entries.name: Guardian Greaves
entries.detail: Removed the additional healing effect of 500 points. Enables quick movement. <Active Skill: Activates when many allied chess pieces are injured> Grants 500 maximum health and 25 mana to all allied units in the area. Dispels negative effects incurred during battle. Effect Range: 500 Cooldown: 15 seconds

entries.name: Necronomicon
entries.detail: Balancing adjustments: Death Prophet's/Necrophos's health: 250~650 / 150~390 (previously 210~930 / 140~620). Duration: 5~21 seconds (previously 4~36 seconds).

entries.name: Added a new Immortal item for Tusk ★★★
Added a new Immortal item for Arc Warden ★★★
Hoodwink- Acorn Shot
entries.detail: Damage increased from 100/150/200 to 150/200/250. Summoned unit vulnerability increased from 50%/75%/100% to 75%/100%/125%.

entries.name: Viper - Corrosive Skin
entries.detail: Damage per second reduced from 40/50/60 to 30/40/50.

entries.name: Added a lineup box (Hold L key, similar to the expression wheel K) to provide quick operations for adjusting formation positions: gather front/back, gather left/right, swap left/right, swap front/back, and disperse

The player details panel and endgame panel will now display all the Relic consecutively selected in the game. Used Relic will appear in grey in the equipment compendium panel and the bottom left Relic pool panel
Optimized some UI icons and styles
Pet Hosting
entries.detail: Operating chess pieces with the courier will now automatically disable pet hosting (previously, pets were eager to take control).

entries.name: Pet Hosting
entries.detail: The currently hosted pet will now appear larger.

entries.name: The EoS rewards for S28 Mad Mac (01/11 to 31/12) is based on the following
entries.detail: ♕Top 20 Queens (on Leaderboard): S28 Badge + ♕Queen rewards. ♕Queen: 320 Candies + Crown (valid for S29) + Mad Mac Red. ♔King: 320 Candies + Mad Mac Purple. ♖Rook: 160 Candies + Mad Mac Blue. ♗Bishop: 80 Candies + Mad Mac Green. ♘Knight: 40 Candies. ♙Pawn: 20 Candies.

entries.name: Top 20 Queens are rewarded based on their final places and the other ranks for the highest rank achieved in the season

As usual, the last day of the season will be the off-season break to award the excellent players. Games played on the day do not affect Rankings. The new season of S29 Dragon Roar starts on 01/01/2024!
